decisions.executionNote: Approach charger in left workspace with left arm; raise and tip wrist gradually, retaining elbow-up continuity.
Continue left approach above charger, gradually tilting downward and aligning with its long axis.
Bring left gripper over charger with the demonstrated oblique top grasp; monitor wrist centering before descent.
Descend in small increments along the oblique approach and straighten the charger in the left wrist view.
Center the charger between left fingers, settle at grasp height, and close fully; retention remains to be checked by lifting.
Lift charger clear with left fingers held fully closed; verify it stays fixed in the wrist view before handoff.
Charger remains fixed during lift. Rotate left-held plug toward central handoff while raising right receiver gradually within its workspace.
Continue central handoff preparation, keeping the left grip closed and both elbows on the current branch.
Rotate left-held charger toward the right receiver and advance receiver toward central staging, without crossing either arm.
Finish positioning the left giver while aligning right receiver with the exposed charger end; keep clearance until orientation is settled.
Settle giver at the central handoff orientation; bring receiver to a clear pregrasp position before closing distance.
Replan from interrupted prefix with smaller receiver increments; complete opposing handoff alignment without a joint jump.
Advance right receiver toward exposed charger end, using wrist image to center it; left maintains the supporting grasp.
Close the remaining receiver approach gap and align its finger pads around the charger's free end; giver remains stationary and closed.
Close right fingers on the exposed charger end while left still supports it; no release until both grips are visually aligned.
Release left giver and withdraw slightly while right stays closed; check the charger remains in the receiver.
Handoff appears retained by right. Separate arms, begin rotating charger upright over right workspace, and start withdrawing the empty left arm.
Right retains charger during separation. Continue lifting and rotating it toward vertical; retreat left toward home with smooth configuration changes.
Rotate right-held charger toward pins-down orientation aligned with the strip, staying above it; empty left arm continues toward home.
Continue smooth pins-down rotation above the strip while returning the empty left arm; charger remains stable in right wrist view.
Complete the last portion of upright plug orientation at safe height, aligning its pin pair with the strip's socket axis; continue left return.
Finish near-vertical charger orientation, holding above sockets; slow the empty left arm as it nears home.
Lower toward the strip while making a partial lateral correction toward the middle socket; use the closer wrist view to refine alignment before contact.
Refine lateral centering over the middle socket and lower only 15 mm to inspect remaining pin-to-socket alignment before final insertion.
Correct fore-aft socket alignment at near-contact height; keep charger closed and upright while inspecting the socket row relative to its base.
Bring the center socket beneath the pin end using small fore-aft corrections and a shallow descent; inspect before pressing deeper.
Make a slow vertical insertion approach with lateral alignment held fixed; inspect pin seating and strip motion before continuing.
Apply a final shallow vertical seating motion and pause, keeping the plug upright and closed before release.
Release the apparently seated charger and lift the open right gripper clear to check that the charger stays upright in the socket.
Charger remains upright after release. Withdraw the open right gripper safely and start a smooth elbow-up return toward its origin.
Visible pins show the charger is not fully seated. Stop return and reapproach the upright charger to correct fore-aft socket alignment.
The released charger has tipped flat behind the strip. Reorient to an oblique pickup and recenter from RGB rather than treating the earlier release as successful.
Approach the flat charger with open right fingers, centering its body for a fresh grasp while keeping clear of the strip.
Refine the right oblique pickup: advance toward the flat charger and lower gradually, keeping the body centered between open fingers.
Adjust fore-aft pickup centering without further descent; charger is too low in the wrist view, so reposition fingers over its body before closing.
Change to a more vertical pickup while keeping finger tips near the charger; this allows an upright side-held insertion without another transfer.
Finish top-down pickup alignment, with slight fore-aft recentering. Keep fingers open until the charger body sits between the pads.
Close on the centered charger and begin a small test lift; judge actual retention from its motion in the next views.
Lift the newly grasped charger clear and begin turning its pins downward, compensating the wrist translation to keep the charger away from the strip.
Continue turning the retained charger upright while moving its center toward the strip, preserving clearance and a continuous elbow-up posture.
Rotate the side-held charger further toward pins-down while translating the wrist around its center; keep the plug above the strip.
Continue rotating the side grip toward horizontal wrist and vertical charger, bringing the pin center over the middle socket while maintaining height clearance.
Replan from the executed prefix with half-size wrist rotation and translation, keeping the plug elevated while finishing upright alignment.
Finish the gradual side-grip rotation toward upright pins, keeping the charger center elevated and moving it toward socket alignment.
Settle the charger fully upright in its side grip and make a small lateral centering adjustment before a slow vertical approach.
Lower the now-upright charger vertically in the side grasp, keeping the pins over the middle socket and checking the closing gap.
Continue vertical approach with a tiny lateral correction to center the pin pair over the middle socket; stop short of seating to inspect the remaining gap.
Wrist tracking worsened near the low approach. Avoid further lowering the link; gently tip the wrist a few degrees to bring the pins down while maintaining lateral centering.
Pins now appear at the socket plane. Apply only a 4 mm seating increment and pause, watching for strip displacement or loss of alignment.
Maintain pin centering and advance another 6 mm slowly toward flush seating; check the base-to-strip gap before opening.
Open the right fingers after shallow seating and withdraw slightly upward and back, checking whether the charger remains upright and flush in the socket.
Visible exposed pins indicate incomplete insertion. Regrasp the upright charger with a leveled side grip before correcting its pin row alignment.
The charger tipped during regrasp, so reopen and lift clear. Reorient for a top pickup nearer its USB end to keep the wrist higher during insertion.
Replan the rejected escape using quarter-size increments, opening and rising away from the fallen charger while retaining the current IK branch.
Use a minimal first escape increment to satisfy continuity from the last accepted target, then slowly increase lift and wrist tip after clearing the low pose.
Lift and tilt the open right wrist toward a top-down recovery grasp, keeping clear of the charger and strip while moving away from the low wrist limit.
Replan the interrupted recovery with smaller lift and wrist increments; seek a higher-on-body grasp so final insertion will not require the low wrist limit.
Lift and advance the open right gripper toward the charger's USB half, gradually turning downward while preserving the current elbow branch.
Continue the top-down recovery approach around the charger, raising the wrist as it tips down and aligning the jaw axis with the body.
Turn farther downward and approach the USB half for a higher grasp; correct the visible yaw offset before closing.
Finish the near-vertical pickup orientation while keeping the USB end in the finger-pad region, so the next upright grip holds higher on the charger.
Close around the USB end at the current near-vertical approach and make a small retention-check lift before deciding any further rotation.
The higher USB-end grasp is retained. Lift clear and begin rotating the charger pins downward while moving its center toward the socket.
Keep the higher grasp closed and continue rotating toward upright, compensating wrist position to maintain clearance over the strip.
Continue the upright rotation around the securely held USB end, maintaining clearance and keeping the pin center near the middle socket.
Slow the last upright rotation and pivot the wrist about the higher grasp, avoiding the previous low-wrist tracking limit.
Continue the slow pivot toward upright while maintaining the retained high grip and keeping the charger clear of the socket surface.
Finish most of the remaining upright rotation with a compensated pivot; keep the higher body grasp closed and avoid the previous low-wrist limit.
Complete upright alignment in the high grasp. Move the empty left wrist within its workspace to gain a side view of pin seating, since the right view is occluded.
Approach seating slowly with the high right grasp while moving the empty left wrist toward a clear inspection angle, staying left of center.
Gain an unobstructed left-wrist view while lowering the right-held charger only 5 mm; do not release until pin seating can be checked.
Hold the charger steady while bringing the left inspection view closer to the pin row, keeping the empty arm in its own workspace.
Adjust only the empty left wrist's viewing angle so the charger base and socket are visible; right remains stationary and closed.
Use a raised left inspection viewpoint instead of the rejected wrist rotation; keep right charger pose fixed while checking socket alignment.
The side view now shows the charger base near the socket. Lower only 6.5 mm with the high grasp and inspect for flush seating before releasing.
The side view suggests the base meets the strip. Open gradually without translating either wrist, then inspect whether the charger remains upright and flush.
Withdraw the open right gripper upward and backward without touching the charger; use the left view to verify upright retention and base seating.
Charger tipped back after release, confirming fore-aft misalignment. Recover the high grasp again, then shift the upright pin row toward the robot before insertion.
Use half-sized recovery increments after the continuity rejection; lift clear while gradually tipping toward the fallen charger's USB end.
Continue raising and tipping the open right wrist over the charger; maintain the left inspection view for the later fore-aft correction.
Reduce the rejected recovery increments to preserve wrist-joint continuity while lifting and advancing toward the charger.
Advance the open wrist above the fallen charger while tipping downward and correcting its changed yaw before another grasp.
Continue to a clearer top-down pickup view, recentering the body before closing; keep the inspection arm stationary.
Align the open jaws with the changed charger yaw and approach its upper half from above, using the side camera to preserve strip clearance.
Finish the vertical approach over the USB half while compensating fingertip position; retain clearance before closing.
Center the open jaws on the USB half, descend a small amount, then close for a high body grasp; retention will be checked before rotation.
